name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
summary: Governs processing of digital personal data in India, including consent, purpose limitation, and rules on transfers outside India.

source.title: MeitY: Data Protection Framework
source.publisher: Ministry of Electronics and IT, India

name: RBI Storage of Payment System Data
summary: Payment system providers must store full end-to-end payment data only in India; data for the foreign leg of a transaction may also be stored abroad.

source.title: RBI/2017-18/153: Storage of Payment System Data

name: CERT-In Directions
summary: Indian Computer Emergency Response Team directions on reporting cyber security incidents and maintaining logs.

name: DoT M2M SIM and eSIM Rules
summary: Department of Telecommunications requirements for machine-to-machine SIMs and eSIM profiles on connected devices operating in India.

name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012
summary: Singapore's baseline law for collection, use, disclosure, and cross-border transfer of personal data.

name: MAS Technology Risk Management Guidelines
summary: MAS expectations for financial institutions on technology risk governance, resilience, cryptography, and cyber security.

name: MAS Advisory on Cybersecurity Risks Associated with Quantum
summary: MAS advisory on cyber security risks from quantum computing, with mitigating measures financial institutions should consider.

source.title: MAS/TCRS/2024/01: Advisory on Addressing the Cybersecurity Risks Associated with Quantum

name: Cybersecurity Act (Critical Information Infrastructure)
summary: Obligations for owners of Critical Information Infrastructure in sectors including aviation, maritime, banking, and energy.

name: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (as amended 2024)
summary: Malaysia's personal data law, relevant to operations in Johor and the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone.

summary: IMO guidance on maritime cyber risk management, including protection of ship operational technology.
